_comment: Editor cover-art image prompt (studio cover generator). positionDescriptions map the UI's position values onto canvas wording; textLines/blocks are assembled by cover_prompt.py.

positionDescriptions.top: upper third of the canvas (approximately top 30% horizontal band)
positionDescriptions.center: central horizontal band of the canvas (middle 30%)
positionDescriptions.bottom: lower third of the canvas (approximately bottom 30% horizontal band)

typographyBlock:
COVER TYPOGRAPHY (render only the exact text listed below — do not invent or substitute other words):
{cover_text_section}

Typography rules:
- Use the EXACT spelling shown above. Do not paraphrase, abbreviate, or use placeholder words.
- Title: largest and boldest text on the cover; legible at Amazon thumbnail size.
- Subtitle: clearly smaller than the title.
- Author: smallest of the three, clean byline style.
- High contrast between text and background; balance text within each zone.

textRules.withText: 1. Render only the cover typography listed above. Do not add any other words, slogans, or labels beyond what the user specified.
textRules.withoutText: 1. NO title text, subtitle, author name, slogans, or decorative phrases in the image — artwork only.
